title: Computing transient probabilities in Markovian queues with balking conditional on a fixed number of joined customers
summary: We analyze the transient behavior of a Markovian queue with balking, conditional on exactly $K$ customers joining the system in a finite time interval $[0, T]$. A key quantity of interest is the cumulative number of balking customers, for which we consider the probability generating function (PGF) and derive an equation it satisfies.
